pinnedFiles.reason: The only locator violation in lib/site/ (verified by grepping registerElement + has-text|:text|nth- across the whole directory): line 22 registers completeTransactionBtn with `button:has-text("COMPLETE TRANSACTION")`. This is the file AC2 names directly — must become `[data-testid="complete-transaction-btn"]`.

Renders the complete-transaction button. It already carries a data-testid, but the wrong one (`data-testid="checkout-btn"` at line 61) — must be renamed to `complete-transaction-btn` to satisfy AC2. Grepped repo-wide for `checkout-btn`: this is the only occurrence, so the rename is isolated.

Boundary case for AC3: line 20 uses the Playwright locator method `.nth(1)` (not a CSS `nth-` pseudo-selector) against an existing data-testid. Flag so the developer doesn't misread AC3's literal 'nth-' wording as requiring a change here — it isn't a selector string and isn't in scope.

Boundary case for AC1/AC3: line 18 does `this.page.locator('h2')` — a bare tag selector outside any registerElement call. Not has-text/:text/nth-/nesting, so it is not a violation under the AC's literal wording; flagged so it is explicitly left alone rather than 'fixed' as scope creep.
